slips.source: Translates text between 57 languages using [TranslateGemma](https://ollama.com/library/translategemma) running locally on your GPU via [Ollama](https://ollama.com). No API keys, no cloud, no rate limits — by default everything stays on your machine. You can opt in to a remote Ollama such as [Ollama Cloud](#ollama-cloud-optional).
